educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: TORQUE & INERTIA
missions.concept: Required joint torque depends on gravity, moment arm and rotational inertia; distal mass is disproportionately expensive.
missions.scenario: Explore how mass, distance from the axis and acceleration change shoulder demand.
missions.goalText: Keep the design/task under a 28 N·m joint envelope.
missions.transferText: Recover torque margin after an imposed tool extension increases the effective moment arm.

missions.title: MOTOR VS TRANSMISSION
missions.concept: A transmission trades motor speed for output torque and changes reflected inertia; motor capability cannot be read from output torque alone.
missions.scenario: Select motor capability and reduction for a joint. The mission torque/speed requirements are fixed evidence.
missions.goalText: Meet torque, speed and reflected-inertia requirements simultaneously.
missions.transferText: Adapt the drivetrain to the new speed requirement. The displayed metric and the pass logic now use the same requirement.

missions.title: GEAR RATIO TRADE-OFFS
missions.concept: Higher reduction multiplies torque but divides speed and squares reflected motor inertia; there is no universally best ratio.
missions.scenario: Tune a knee drivetrain. Motor inertia is supplied by the selected motor and cannot be edited directly.
missions.goalText: Find a balanced ratio instead of maximizing one headline number.
missions.transferText: Use the new motor property to choose a better ratio; you cannot edit the motor inertia itself.

missions.title: CONTINUOUS VS PEAK
missions.concept: Peak torque is a short-duration capability; continuous capability is governed by thermal conditions and duty cycle.
missions.scenario: A crouch passes once. Event duration is imposed by the repeated task; you may change torque demand and cooling.
missions.goalText: Pass both the instantaneous torque limit and the thermal-duration limit.
missions.transferText: The peak rating did not change. Adapt demand/cooling to make repetition sustainable.

missions.title: POWER & THERMAL LIMITS
missions.concept: Torque, speed, electrical current and cooling form one operating envelope; repeated high-power motion can derate a healthy actuator.
missions.scenario: Run a fast lift. Ambient thermal penalty is imposed by the environment.
missions.goalText: Deliver useful torque while staying inside power and thermal envelopes.
missions.transferText: Adapt after the environment removes thermal headroom.

missions.title: ACTUATION GATE
missions.concept: Integrate torque, inertia, ratio, power and thermal reasoning instead of optimizing a joint by one headline number.
missions.scenario: Release a shoulder actuator package for three imposed mission conditions.
missions.goalText: Complete the three actuator gate cases.

gateCases.name: STATIC + DYNAMIC LOAD
gateCases.text: Available output torque must exceed the imposed load by 20%.

gateCases.name: AGILITY
gateCases.text: Keep output speed proxy above 3 rad/s and reflected inertia below 0.14.

gateCases.name: POWER / THERMAL
gateCases.text: Keep mechanical power below the imposed limit while retaining 15 N·m torque margin.
